sharedRules.name: Nurgle's Gift (Aura)
sharedRules.description:
If your Army Faction is DEATH GUARD, while an enemy unit is within 3", 6", 9" in battle rounds 1, 2, 3 respectively (using the final range in later battle rounds) (to a maximum of 12", extensions included) of one or more friendly DEATH GUARD models, that unit is Afflicted.
When declaring Battle Formations, for the rest of the battle, if your Army Faction is DEATH GUARD, choose one of the following (Plague): while making ranged attacks, while the attacking unit is an enemy unit that is Afflicted, the target has the Benefit of Cover; while making melee attacks, while the attacking unit is an enemy unit that is Afflicted, subtract 1 from the Hit rolls of enemy units that are Afflicted / worsen the Save characteristic of enemy units that are Afflicted by 1 / worsen the Move characteristic of enemy units that are Afflicted by 1; worsen the Leadership characteristic of enemy units that are Afflicted by 1; worsen the Objective Control characteristic of enemy units that are Afflicted by 1, to a minimum of 1; subtract 1 from the Toughness characteristic of enemy units that are Afflicted.

  - Select one enemy unit that is within 24" of this model and visible to this model (your Virulent Blessing Target). Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly unit makes an attack against it, if the attacking unit has the PLAGUE LEGIONS keyword, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that attack.

characteristics.$text: Set this unit's Leadership characteristic to 6+.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Add 1 to this unit's Charge rolls.

rules.name: Worldblight
rules.description:
At the end of your Command phase:
  For each friendly DEATH GUARD unit:
    - Objective markers that unit controls remain under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over them is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
    - The objective that this unit was controlling when the rule was triggered is Secured.
  - Until you no longer control that objective marker:
    For each enemy unit: While this unit is within range of an objective marker you control tagged secured, that unit is Afflicted.

rules.name: Verminous Haze
rules.description:
For the rest of the battle, select up to 2 friendly PLAGUE MARINES units. Those units gain the Infiltrators ability.
Applies to: DEATH GUARD PLAGUE MARINES units.

rules.name: Reverberant Rancidity
rules.description:
While a friendly PLAGUE LEGIONS unit is within 7" of a friendly DEATH GUARD unit, that unit gains the Nurgle's Gift (Aura) ability.
While a friendly DEATH GUARD unit is within 7" of a friendly PLAGUE LEGIONS unit, increase the range of that unit's Nurgle's Gift (Aura) ability by 3".

rules.name: Manifold Maladies
rules.description: At the start of the battle round, for the rest of the battle, the options of this unit's Nurgle's Gift (Aura) ability are reselect plague.

rules.name: Miasmic Bombardment
rules.description: At the start of the battle round, while this unit is not within 12" of a friendly unit, until the end of the battle round, enemy units are Afflicted.

rules.name: Numberless Horde
rules.description: During your Command phase, add a Poxwalkers unit to your army in Strategic Reserves.

rules.name: Deadly Vectors
rules.description:
During your opponent's Command phase:
  For each enemy unit that is Afflicted:
    - While this unit is Below Half-strength:
      - Roll 2D6: on a 7 or less, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
    - Unless this unit is Below Half-strength:
      - Roll 2D6: on a 6 or less, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

rules.name: Warped and Rusted Animus
rules.description:
Friendly units with the FOETID BLOAT-DRONE, FOETID BLOAT-DRONE WITH HEAVY BLIGHT LAUNCHER, HELBRUTE or MYPHITIC BLIGHT-HAULER keyword gain the CONTAGION ENGINES keyword.
Ranged weapons equipped by friendly CONTAGION ENGINES units gain [ASSAULT].
You cannot select this Detachment together with another ENGINES Detachment.
Applies to: DEATH GUARD units.

rules.name: Hypervirulent Strains
rules.description:
Increase the range of friendly CHARACTER DEATH GUARD units' Nurgle's Gift (Aura) ability by 3" (to a maximum of 12).
Applies to: DEATH GUARD CHARACTER units.

characteristics.$text: When a friendly PLAGUE LEGIONS unit is set up, if the triggering unit is using Deep Strike, while the triggering unit is wholly within 12" of this model, that unit can be set up on the battlefield more than 6" away from all enemy models.

At the start of the Battle Shock step in your opponent's turn:
  For each enemy unit within 6" of this model: While this unit is below its Starting Strength, that unit must take a Battle-shock test, applying -1 to that test.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When this unit takes a Battle-shock test, while a friendly PLAGUE LEGIONS unit is within 12" of this model, add 1 to that unit's Battle-shock rolls; if the triggering battle shock roll succeeded, unless this unit has the BATTLELINE keyword and the triggering battle shock roll succeeded, one model in that unit regains up to D3 lost wounds; if this unit has the BATTLELINE keyword and the triggering battle shock roll succeeded, return D3 destroyed models to that unit, each with its full wounds remaining.

While this model is within 3" of a friendly DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit:
  - This model gains the Lone Operative ability.
  - While making ranged attacks, while the target unit is an enemy unit and the target is visible to this model, you can re-roll Wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly DEATH GUARD VEHICLE units within 3" of this model.
